name: Deliverance From Enemies
overview: Scripture reveals that deliverance from enemies is a profound demonstration of God's power and faithfulness to His people. The psalmist declares the LORD as a mighty rock, fortress, and deliverer who rescues from overwhelming foes, providing strength and protection (Psalms 18:2, 17). Believers are called to trust in God’s shepherding care, confidently seeking His help in times of distress (Psalms 23:1; 55:1). Ultimately, salvation from enemies is secured through faith in Jesus Christ, who saves not only individuals but their households from the hand of those who hate them (Luke 1:71; Acts 16:31).
